Bug_Title: "ThreadLocal" variables should be cleaned up when no longer used
Bug_Explanation: ThreadLocal variables should be cleaned up when no longer used. The noncompliant use of ThreadLocal's set() method leads to memory leaks when the holding thread is no longer alive.
Trigger_Explanation: The 'incorrectCleanup' method and'showBug1' method of 'ThreadLocalUserSession' class trigger the bug by setting ThreadLocal variable to null and getting the value without calling'remove' method.
